caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: bearish, mid range · 1d: bullish, upper third · 4h: range, upper third · 1h: transition, lower third · 15m: range, upper third. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.
